theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_bml_rescaled_box_inclusions
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s η s' : ℝ), a ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < η → 0 < s' → 20 * s' < 1 → 30 * s' < η → 6 * s' < s → dilation a s' ⁻¹' {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ < 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| < 1 - η ∧ |inner ℝ w e| < 1 - η} ⊆ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∧ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ ball a (3 * s') ⊆ dilation a s' ⁻¹' {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ ≤ 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| ≤ 1 + η ∧ |inner ℝ w e| ≤ 1 + η}
